name: Government Integrated Data Center, Singha Durbar
developer: Integrated Data Management Center / National Information Technology Center, Government of Nepal
notes: Government IDMC/NITC operates the national Government Integrated Data Center at Singha Durbar, providing government hosting, domains, email, backup and network services for thousands of public offices.

name: Government Disaster Recovery Center, Hetauda
developer: National Information Technology Center / Government of Nepal; KOICA-supported construction
notes: Backup/disaster-recovery site for the Government Integrated Data Center; sources place it at Huprachaur, Hetauda, and state it came into operation in May 2019.

name: Nepal Electricity Authority Data Center, Syuchatar/Suchatar Kathmandu
notes: NEA launched a Tier-3-standard Kathmandu data center under its Digital NEA program; reports describe 36 server rooms/four network rooms and two 1MW generators.

name: WorldLink Data World / Chandragiri Data Center
developer: WorldLink Communications Ltd. / Data World Pvt. Ltd.
notes: WorldLink launched a 3.5MW, 520-rack data center at Chandragiri/Matatirtha near the Mata Tirtha substation, positioned for cloud, AI and carrier-neutral services.

name: Yotta-BLC K1 SuperCloud Data Center, near Kathmandu/Ramkot
developer: Yotta Data Services; BLC Holding Pvt. Ltd.
notes: Official Yotta announcement says the purpose-built K1 facility near Kathmandu will provide cloud, managed IT and cyber-security services; trade sources specify about 60,000 sq ft and up to 4MW critical IT load.

name: Bichuten Data Vault Tier IV Hyperscale Data Centers, Chobhar and Birgunj
notes: Bichuten announced two hydro-powered Tier-IV/hyperscale facilities in Chobhar, Kathmandu and Birgunj, starting with roughly 240kW initial capacity and scaling toward 5MW combined by 2030.

name: Nepal Telecom Primary Data Center, Kathmandu
notes: Nepal Telecom selected Huawei for a roughly NPR 484 million project covering a primary data center in Kathmandu and a separate disaster-recovery center in Bhairahawa.

name: Nepal Telecom Disaster Recovery Center, Bhairahawa
notes: Companion disaster-recovery site for Nepal Telecom's Kathmandu primary data center project; sources place the DR center in Bhairahawa.

name: Ncell Nakkhu Integrated Data Centre
notes: Ncell's official pages market Tier III cloud/colocation services and announce ANSI/TIA-942-C Rated 3 certification for the Nakkhu, Lalitpur Integrated Data Centre; DataCenterMap lists the Nakkhu facility at 5MW.

name: DataHub Kathmandu Data Center
notes: DataHub's official site lists data-center, colocation, backup, DR, object-storage and cloud services from Shikhar Biz Center, Thapathali; older local coverage describes the Thapathali facility as a Tier II data center.

name: DataHub Butwal Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings identify a DataHub-operated Butwal facility on Banbatika Road/Tilottama and show DataHub operating two Nepal data centers; official DataHub site confirms the provider's data-center service line but not detailed Butwal specifications.

name: Cloud Himalaya Data Center, Thapathali Kathmandu
notes: Cloud Himalaya's official site and contact page identify a data-center location at Central Business Park, Thapathali, Kathmandu and market Tier-4-style redundant cloud/hosting services; aggregator listings describe the site as a Nepal data center.

name: AccessWorld Data Center, Lalitpur/Kathmandu
notes: AccessWorld states it owns and operates its own data centre for cloud services; contact details place the company at Patan Dhoka/Krishna Galli, Lalitpur, matching data-center aggregator listings.

name: Dataspace Putalisadak Data Center
notes: Dataspace's official site describes the company as Nepal's first data center and places it at Putalisadak, Kathmandu; DataCenterMap identifies the Putalisadak PTS facility and describes neutral colocation/telco-hotel services.
